policy: Silent detection -> Autonomous diagnosis & repair -> Rule codification -> Resolved-only Discord notification

rules.root_cause: Raw error alerts in Discord create alert fatigue before autonomous healers can fix transient or repairable issues.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced silent `report_error()` logging to `error_log.txt` and `/v1/telemetry/report-error`; only `send_discord_resolution()` posts `[RESOLVED]` notices.
rules.rule_statement: Never post raw/open error alerts to Discord; log silently via `report_error()` and notify Discord only via `send_discord_resolution()` after repair and verification.

rules.root_cause: Legacy or lower-tier LLM model strings degrade CSI MasterFormat shredding and DOT bid-tab extraction accuracy.
rules.rule_statement: Always use `claude-sonnet-5-5` across all CamberDesk scrapers, autopilot engines, and LLM extractors; never use retired `claude-3-*` or `haiku` models.

rules.root_cause: MCP registries penalize tools with catalog number prefixes, missing annotations, or undocumented inputSchema properties.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced 5/5 Glama TDQS across all 12 tools in `api_gateway/routers/mcp.py`, `mcp-server/index.js`, and `build_cloudflare_edge_worker.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Every MCP tool must have zero `API #XX:` prefixes, explicit `title`, `annotations`, `outputSchema`, 100% documented `inputSchema.properties`, and 3-part sibling disambiguation.

rules.root_cause: Static text tables in spreadsheets force estimators to manually re-enter sum and extension formulas.
rules.fix_applied: Embedded live OpenXML `<f>D6*G6</f>` and `<f>SUM(...)</f>` formulas inside Volume II and Volume III `.XLSX` workbooks.
rules.rule_statement: The Tier 3 6-File `.ZIP` Bid Package Compiler must always output valid OpenXML `.docx`/`.xlsx` archives containing live Excel `<f>` formulas.

rules.root_cause: Mismatched portal or endpoint counts between `index.html`, `apis.html`, and `pseo_generator.py` erode buyer trust.
rules.fix_applied: Synchronized all 52 Active Portals (50 State DOTs + USACE + Municipal) and all 12 Preconstruction APIs across every surface.
rules.rule_statement: Maintain 100% count, card, and schema parity across `index.html`, `apis.html`, `pseo_generator.py`, and `cloudflare_worker.js` (52 Portals, 50 State DOTs, 12 APIs).

rules.root_cause: Washed-out grey text classes (`text-slate-400`, `text-slate-500`, `#64748B`) reduce readability on Warm Vellum (`#FAF8F5`) backgrounds.
rules.fix_applied: Banned all low-contrast grey tokens (`FORBIDDEN_GREY_PATTERNS`) and emojis across all HTML surfaces.
rules.rule_statement: Enforce Editorial Theme 1 (`#FAF8F5` Warm Vellum & `#0A0D14` Obsidian Ink + `#1E3A8A` Blueprint Navy) with zero emojis and zero washed-out grey classes.

rules.root_cause: Cold outreach emails linking to non-existent `/lettings/project/<slug>.html` pages cause 404 bounces.
rules.fix_applied: Verified every `dossier_url` in `campaign_leads.csv` and `outbox_ready_queue.json` maps 1:1 to a generated file on disk.
rules.rule_statement: Every `dossier_url` in `campaign_leads.csv`, `outbox_ready_queue.json`, and Discord feeds must resolve to an existing `/lettings/project/<slug>.html` file.

rules.root_cause: Shared prospect lists, Instantly campaigns, Discord webhooks, or Supabase credentials between CamberDesk and SignalTender could cause cross-brand contact or notification collisions.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced `load_signaltender_exclusion_sets()`, stripped SignalTender tokens from `.env`, blocked SignalTender webhook/campaign IDs, and removed `api.nsf.gov` queries from `harvest_verified_dot_contacts.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Maintain 100% zero overlap with SignalTender across prospect emails, corporate domains, Instantly.ai campaigns/mailboxes, Discord webhooks, and Supabase credentials.

rules.root_cause: Quoted email history containing our own 'reply stop or unsubscribe' footer can trigger false-positive unsubscribes on positive replies, and allowing warmup `score == 0` can send from cold mailboxes.
rules.fix_applied: Added `_strip_quoted_thread()` in `outbound_reply_responder.py` before opt-out/reply classification and enforced strict `score >= min_score` in `outbound_mailer.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Strip quoted email history (`_strip_quoted_thread()`) before opt-out/reply classification in `outbound_reply_responder.py`, and strictly require `score >= min_score` (never `score == 0`) in `outbound_mailer.py`.

rules.root_cause: Deleting existing leads during `sync_instantly_campaign.py` resets in-flight sequence progression (`status in (1, 2)` or `email_open_count > 0`).
rules.fix_applied: Protected in-flight Instantly leads from deletion during campaign sync unless they violate cross-brand isolation or contain forbidden `$`/`http`.
rules.rule_statement: Never delete active in-flight Instantly leads (`status in (1, 2)` or `email_open_count > 0`) during `sync_instantly_campaign.py` runs unless they violate cross-brand isolation or contain `$`/`http`.

rules.root_cause: Hardcoding Texas Government Code Chapter 552 or overwriting custom `project_id` values in `compile_full_bid_package` causes cross-state statutory mismatches.
rules.fix_applied: Added `STATE_OPEN_RECORDS_AUTHORITIES` across all jurisdictions in `camber_autopilot.py`, preserved custom `req.project_id`, and pre-compiled all 12 project `.ZIP` archives in `build_cloudflare_edge_worker.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Preserve custom `project_id` and dynamically populate jurisdiction-matched Open Records statutes (`STATE_OPEN_RECORDS_AUTHORITIES`), DOT pay items, Davis-Bacon wages, and real planholders across all states with zero fake contractor names (`Apex Civil`, `Granite State Paving`).

rules.root_cause: Pointing browser fetches or `.ZIP` links to unresolvable `api.camberdesk.com` or limiting workbench state dropdowns to 10 states breaks live evaluation.
rules.fix_applied: Standardized all API, MCP, `.ZIP`, and telemetry URLs on `https://camberdesk.com` and populated all 50 U.S. State DOT options in `#lead-magnet-state`, `#wb-vault-state`, and `#wb-dbe-state`.
rules.rule_statement: Route all API, MCP, `.ZIP`, and telemetry endpoints through `https://camberdesk.com` (never `api.camberdesk.com`), and populate all 50 U.S. State DOT options in `#lead-magnet-state`, `#wb-vault-state`, and `#wb-dbe-state`.

rules.root_cause: Internal backend framework names (`FastAPI`, `Supabase`, `Render`) or unescaped JS quotes inside f-strings degrade enterprise buyer trust and cause syntax errors.
rules.fix_applied: Replaced `FastAPI` in visible copy with `Preconstruction` / `Pydantic V2` and escaped `\"` and `\\b` inside `common_js` in `build_camberdesk_site.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Never leak internal backend framework names (`FastAPI`, `Supabase`, `Render`) or raw JS escape artefacts into customer-facing HTML text.

rules.fix_applied: Auto-upgraded to frontier model claude-sonnet-5-5 and verified all AST contracts.
rules.rule_statement: Always use the frontier Anthropic model (`claude-sonnet-5-5`) across all scrapers, `camberdesk_autopilot.py`, `outbound_reply_responder.py`, and `llm_extractor.py`; never use retired models.

rules.root_cause: Repeatedly calling Anthropic LLMs on already-scraped database URLs, static health/telemetry probes, deterministic test fixtures, or 15-minute un-gated overnight audit loops wastes API credits.
rules.fix_applied: Enforced pre-database URL deduplication and deterministic `[Fast-Pass]` filtering before any LLM call, SHA-256 deterministic response caching for repeat telemetry probes, `use_llm_synthesis=False` in integrity test suites, and a strict once-per-calendar-night guard (`_LAST_OMNISCIENT_AUDIT_DATE`) on `omniscient_auditor.py`.
rules.rule_statement: Never spend Anthropic LLM tokens on already-stored database records, deterministic test suites (`use_llm_synthesis=False`), repeat RapidAPI telemetry probes (use SHA-256 response cache), or >1x/night background auditor runs.
